steps.message:
﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: logback-classic 1.2.11 -> 1.4.1

## Context

Project `pay-adminusers` (by alphagov) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`ch.qos.logback:logback-classic` from `1.2.11` to `1.4.1` (minor update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/alphagov/pay-adminusers/pull/1594

## Your Task

The source code is in `/pay-adminusers`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll analyze the compilation failure and fix it. Let me start by understanding the project structure and the specific errors.

arguments.description: Run Maven compile to see errors

Let me check what the actual compilation error would be by looking at the Dropwizard version compatibility:

Now I found the compilation error! The issue is:
```
/pay-adminusers/src/test/java/uk/gov/pay/adminusers/queue/event/EventMessageHandlerTest.java:[112,15] cannot access org.slf4j.spi.LoggingEventAware
```

This is related to the logback upgrade. Let me look at the test file:

Now I understand the issue. The problem is with logback 1.4.1 and slf4j version incompatibility. The error is:
```
cannot access org.slf4j.spi.LoggingEventAware
```

The issue is that logback 1.4.x requires slf4j 2.x, but the project is using slf4j 1.7.36. In logback 1.3.x and 1.4.x, there were breaking changes related to slf4j version requirements.

steps.message:
The fix is complete. The compilation was failing because:

**Root Cause:** Logback 1.4.x requires SLF4J 2.x as a dependency, but the project was using SLF4J 1.7.36. The breaking change occurred when logback upgraded from 1.2.x to 1.3.x/1.4.x - they migrated to require SLF4J 2.x API. The error `cannot access org.slf4j.spi.LoggingEventAware` occurred because this interface was added in SLF4J 2.x.

**Fix Applied:** Updated `slf4j-api` from version `1.7.36` to `2.0.3` in `/pay-adminusers/pom.xml`.

Both `mvn compile` and `mvn test-compile` now succeed.
